products.name: Weights & Biases
products.note: ML experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact lineage; W&B Weave adds LLM and agent tracing, evaluation, and guardrails; acquired by CoreWeave

profile_text.body:
Weights & Biases, founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, describes itself as an AI developer platform that serves as a system of record for training AI models and developing AI applications. The platform covers machine learning experiment tracking, a model registry, and artifact lineage. A component called W&B Weave extends the platform to large language model and agent use cases, adding tracing, evaluation, and guardrails. The company states its platform holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, and ISO/IEC 27018:2019 certifications and is compliant with SOC 2 and HIPAA standards, with alignment to GDPR requirements and support for NIST 800-53 compliance.

The held facts note that Weights & Biases has been acquired by CoreWeave. The site's law exposure data associates the company with 174 California entries, though no specific litigation cases are on record here.
